commit.subject: LU-18839 llite: print module version at mount time
commit.message:
LU-18839 llite: print module version at mount time

Print the Lustre version string in the client mount message.
This helps during debugging to know exactly which module version
was running at the time of the mount, in case the modules were
upgraded on a system without being removed and reloaded.
